text:
Nina: quick sync 1: launch posts + webinar landing need a consolidated SEO runbook. Goal: single redirect map, canonical rules, and a keyword allocation so we don't cannibalize. Deadline: Monday morning publish.
Omar: I'll output a SERP intent CSV and label each keyword as primary/secondary/long-tail. Quick note: avoid repeating the exact primary keyword in both meta titles.
Priya: schema split: blog posts = Article + breadcrumbList, webinar = Event + FAQ. Also add SocialMeta (og/twitter) for both.
Jess: internal linking matrix I propose: 1) hero product -> launch post; 2) resources index -> webinar landing; 3) launch post -> benchmark blog (contextual paragraph). Anchors: "LLM inference benchmarks", "Redwood webinar".
Nina: redirects: use 301 for retired paths, preserve query string only for partner tracking, but canonical tags must be clean (no utm).
Omar: sample keyword buckets from quick scan: ["inference benchmarks","llm latency","inference cost","batching strategies","kv cache performance"]. I'll mark which should live on benchmark blog vs launch post vs webinar landing.
Priya: meta titles guidelines: <=60 chars, include brand suffix. Examples: "LLM Inference Benchmarks 2026 1 Redwood" and "Predictable LLM Inference for Teams 1 Redwood".
Jess: QA checklist: sitemap present, canonical verified, redirects (curl -I) return 301, JSON-LD present and valid, mobile Lighthouse pass. Add a quick robots.txt check.
seo-bot: staging-crawl: /old-webinar, /campaign/latency-fallback still 200. Recommend redirect mapping file: CSV with columns old_path,new_path,redirect_type,keep_query.
Nina: action owners: @Omar keywords CSV by Thu, @Priya add JSON-LD + meta by Fri AM, @Jess update internal links and run Lighthouse Fri PM, @Nina assemble redirect CSV and push to #marketing-assets.
Omar: will include search volume and intent column. Also flag any SERP features (people also ask, top stories) to adapt FAQ content.
Priya: for FAQ, short Qs: "What will we cover?", "Who should attend?", "How to watch recording?" Keep answers <220 chars for snippet chance.
Jess: adding internal anchor plan to draft PR now.
Nina: great. I'll run a preflight Saturday AM and publish Monday. Tagging owners. :rocket:
